items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: Yes, she sold to a man named Fox. And he’s like this person at Bourne.

ctx.x: Yes, she sold to a man named Fox. And he’s like this person at Bourne. He wants the moon. And this poor guy, I was going to get him before I got Matthew, to see if he’d want to work on the film. And I never could — I saw him once and he said, “yeah it sounded wonderful.” But I never could get him on the phone. He always had a cold or he was having a nervous breakdown. Because he’s got this treasure and he can’t—
That’s too bad because it stifles things to come out of it that might come later.
